name: Compact 3D Gaussian Representation (C3DGS)
definition: A framework that reduces the number of Gaussian points via a learnable mask strategy and compresses Gaussian attributes (view-dependent color and covariance) using a grid-based neural field and codebooks, achieving over 25x reduced storage and enhanced rendering speed compared to 3DGS.
summary: Compact 3D Gaussian Representation reduces 3D Gaussian Splatting storage and computation by pruning redundant primitives and compressing attributes via a hash-based neural field and geometry codebooks.
